text:
Marta P: quick sync — got 6 marketplace leads this morning that include HW SKUs + SI interest. need to lock down who claims and how we tag them.
Jamal R: ok, from sales side we want SI to drive the tech intro if SI has an existing relationship. otherwise sales owns intro.
Sophie L: can we codify that in the intake? currently intake form has free-text partner name which is messy.
Kevin O: agreed. suggestion: add explicit fields: partner_association (enum: none, named-SI, hw-partner), partner_confidence (low/med/high).
Natalie K: +1. also we should add a "preferred_owner" hint so SDRs can recommend whether SI should claim.
Marta P: nice. operationally: if partner_association=named-SI and partner_confidence=high -> auto-assign to SI queue with 24h claim window. else go to sales queue.
Sophie L: what's the claiming command for SI? we should standardize so automation can pick it up.
Kevin O: current command we use for devx POC claims is:```/claim-lead <lead_id> owner=si owner_team="Partner SI" region=EMEA ttl=24h tags=hw,marketplace```
Jamal R: can we reduce ttl to 12h for HW + high confidence? SI teams are faster on HW deals usually.
Natalie K: 12h ok but we need an auto-nudge cadence: 6h reminder, then escalate at ttl expiry to AE.
Marta P: sounds good. also rule: if SI tries to claim but partner_confidence is low, require manual approval from partnership ops (to avoid misclaims).
Sophie L: who does partnership ops approve? @Jamal R or @Marta P?
Jamal R: partnership ops is partnership@redwood, but for quick cases either me or Marta can approve.
LeadBot: reminder posted — unclaimed SI-assigned leads will trigger a 6h nudge and then escalate at ttl expiry. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood/sops/si-claim-runbook
Natalie K: edge case: HW partner leads where SI is channel partner but not technical integrator — should those still go to SI queue or to sales?
Marta P: route to sales, add tag "channel-only" so SI queues filter them out.
Kevin O: i'll update the intake schema + webhook mapping. will push to staging by EOD.
Sophie L: thanks — once staging has it i'll run a 1h walkthrough with SDRs and the SI onboarding team.
Jamal R: operational checklist: 1) intake schema live 2) claim command documented 3) nudge/escalation configured 4) filter for channel-only tags. who owns checklist?
Marta P: I'll own 1 & 3. Kevin owns 2, Sophie owns 4.
Marta P: ACTION: Kevin update webhook + PR, Sophie schedule walkthrough, Jamal confirm partner contact email list.
Jamal R: on it.
Natalie K: thanks all :thumbsup:
LeadBot: automated note — thread pinned to #partnerships for 48h for follow-ups.
